title: Same Scene, Different Task: Skill Alignment for Compositional Generalization in VLAs
abstract: arXiv:2610.00524v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models often struggle to generalize to skill combinations absent from their fine-tuning demonstrations, even when every constituent skill has been demonstrated. We focus on a vision shortcut as one failure mode: during fine-tuning, visual observations can serve as a proxy for the instruction, so a policy may execute a demonstrated combination associated with similar observations rather than the instructed combination. This motivates training with counterfactual pairs formed by holding a demonstration observation fixed while changing the instruction to specify an undemonstrated combination. These pairs, however, lack corresponding demonstrated action targets. Crucially, the currently required skill has already been demonstrated, but actions from those executions cannot serve as direct targets because the same skill can require different actions across observations. translated_title: 相同场景，不同任务：面向视觉-语言-动作模型组合泛化的技能对齐
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通常难以泛化到微调演示中未曾出现的技能组合，即使其中每一个组成技能都已被演示过。我们聚焦于一种失败模式——视觉捷径：在微调过程中，视觉观测可以充当指令的替代品，因此策略可能会执行与相似观测相关联的已演示组合，而不是执行指令所要求的组合。这促使我们使用反事实对进行训练，即在保持演示观测不变的同时改变指令，以指定一个未演示过的组合。然而，这些反事实对缺少相应的已演示动作目标。关键在于，当前所需的技能其实已经被演示过，但来自那些执行的动作不能直接作为目标，因为同一技能在不同观测下可能需要不同的动作。我们提出CRAFT，它将监督……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出CRAFT方法，通过构建“观测固定、指令改变”的反事实训练对，并将已演示技能的动作监督迁移到未演示的新组合上，从而解决VLA模型因视觉捷径而产生的组合泛化失败问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes CRAFT, which constructs counterfactual training pairs with fixed observations and altered instructions to transfer action supervision from demonstrated skills to undemonstrated combinations, addressing vision-shortcut-induced failures in compositional generalization for VLAs.
